description: The commit history of a synthetic upstream for a preflight that is a plain git diff (SPEC-03 AC23). A nested git repository cannot be committed to this one, so the tests/s3 helpers materialise this recipe into a real bare repository on disk. The tracked paths of the edge are content, assets, src, index.html and README.md; docs and .github are not tracked.

commits.message: change only what is not tracked
